title: Keybind Settings GUI
description: Keybinds Setting is a mod that, when you press a key (e.g. B), opens a simple GUI allowing you to quickly change assigned keybinds (such as movement or jumping) without going into the game settings.
body:
Keybinds Setting is a lightweight, quality-of-life mod designed to streamline how you manage your controls in-game. Instead of navigating through multiple menus in the standard settings interface, the mod lets you press a designated key (for example, **B**) to instantly open a clean, minimalistic GUI overlay. From there, you can quickly view and reassign keybinds for various actions such as movement, jumping, sprinting, or interacting.

The interface is built to be intuitive and fast, making it especially useful during gameplay when you need to adjust controls on the fly without interrupting your flow. Whether you’re experimenting with new key layouts, fixing conflicts between mods, or simply optimizing your setup for comfort, everything can be done in a few clicks directly from this popup.

Additionally, the mod often includes features like:

* Real-time key reassignment without restarting or leaving the game
* Clear indication of conflicting keybinds
* Support for modded actions alongside default controls
* A compact and responsive design that doesn’t clutter the screen

Overall, Keybinds Setting enhances convenience and accessibility, saving time and making control customization much more seamless, especially for players who frequently tweak their key setups.
